parameters.query:
insert into lawnet.engagements(candidate_ref, lawyer_id, route_code, country_iso2, employer_ref, status, match_score, sla_due_at)
values ($1, $2::uuid, nullif($3,''), $4, nullif($5,''), 'lawyer_notified', $6::numeric, now() + ($7 || ' hours')::interval)
returning id as engagement_id, lawyer_id, sla_due_at,
  (select email from lawnet.lawyers where id = $2::uuid) as lawyer_email,
  (select whatsapp_e164 from lawnet.lawyers where id = $2::uuid) as lawyer_wa,
  (select full_name from lawnet.lawyers where id = $2::uuid) as lawyer_name;

parameters.subject: ={{ 'New case ' + $('Validate Case').first().json.candidate_ref + ' · ' + ($('Validate Case').first().json.route || $('Validate Case').first().json.country) }}
parameters.html:
={{ `

Dear ${$json.lawyer_name},

An anonymised case matches your profile:

  • Case: ${$('Validate Case').first().json.candidate_ref}
  • Country / route: ${$('Validate Case').first().json.country} · ${$('Validate Case').first().json.route || 'to be advised'}
  • Trade: ${$('Validate Case').first().json.trade || '-'}
  • Flagged blocks: ${$('Validate Case').first().json.blocks.join(', ') || 'none'}

Please reply ACCEPT or DECLINE (with fee quote) before ${new Date($json.sla_due_at).toUTCString()}.

` }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', to: $json.lawyer_wa.replace('+',''), type: 'template', template: { name: 'lawnet_new_case', language: { code: 'en' }, components: [ { type: 'body', parameters: [ { type: 'text', text: String($json.lawyer_name) }, { type: 'text', text: String($('Validate Case').first().json.candidate_ref) }, { type: 'text', text: String($('Validate Case').first().json.country) } ] } ] } }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, engagement_id: $('Create Engagement').first().json.engagement_id, lawyer_ref: $('Match Lawyers').first().json.public_ref, sla_due_at: $('Create Engagement').first().json.sla_due_at }) }}

parameters.subject: ={{ '⚠ No verified lawyer for ' + $('Validate Case').first().json.country + ' ' + ($('Validate Case').first().json.route || '') }}
parameters.html:
={{ `

Case ${$('Validate Case').first().json.candidate_ref} needs a lawyer in ${$('Validate Case').first().json.country} for route ${$('Validate Case').first().json.route || 'any'} (language ${$('Validate Case').first().json.lang}). No verified lawyer with referral consent and free capacity. Recruit one via workflow 05 / sign-up form.

` }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, reason: 'no_lawyer_available', escalated: true }) }}
